newsitem.title: SPAIN: Masked attackers damage Socialist centre in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Masked attackers damage Socialist centre in Spain.

text.p: A dozen masked attackers burned a Socialist party centre in Spain's northern Basque region on Friday, police said. There were no injuries.
They forced their way into the building at about 2.15 p.m., sprinkled petrol and set it on fire.
About a dozen people, including two children, were forced into an inner room but were able to escape through a back door.

"This attack was done by fascist apprentices, who by not achieving their political objectives by democratic means are using their most base instincts: violence and fanaticism," the Basque region Socialist party said in a statement.
